name: What He Carried
source:
Toby is late. He's so late that he doesn't watch where he's going and crashes into a burly wall of a bear! Mind helping that innocent bystander put their things back together?

[From [url=https://boyfail-inc.itch.io/what-he-carried]Itch.io[/url]]
